mathematical_audit.parametrization: Solving the two row equations gives r=6M-7p and s=(5p-4M-1)/2. Positivity gives the interval [(4M+3)/5,(6M-1)/7], whose Chebyshev mass is (2/35)M+o(M).
mathematical_audit.alignment: Combining the fixed-M displacement (2d,-14d,5d) with r-shift 6j gives 3j=-7d. Hence j=7k,d=-3k and the returned row is (r+42k,s-15k,p-6k).
mathematical_audit.prime_pairs: For each fixed nonzero offset h, the unconditional Brun-Selberg upper-bound sieve gives O_h(M/log^2 M) prime pairs in the interval, hence O_h(M/log M) logarithmic mass. A fixed finite union is o(M).
mathematical_audit.isolated_mass: Subtracting the fixed-offset pair support from the full interval leaves (2/35)M+o(M), so a mechanism requiring a second prime row at one of finitely many offsets cannot constrain the full-capacity isolated complement.
mathematical_audit.comparison_module: V_M(r)=(1,6M-r)^T transforms by an integral unipotent matrix under every translation. On a selected row 6M-r=7p, and saturation by the fixed unit factor 7 leaves carrier p on every candidate row.
mathematical_audit.scope_limit: No value of either actual target-retaining carrier is replaced by the comparison module. The theorem closes fixed bounded-window propagation as a black-box mechanism, not the actual fixed-j=2 collision set.
